title: Kraft collection
description: The .kraft/collection.json at a collection's root: who publishes it and which of its directories are Kraft plugins.

name.description: The collection's id: its key in plugins.yaml and the part after @ in plugin ids (release@acme).

plugins.description: Entry names must be unique and no source may be inside another; Kraft checks both, JSON Schema cannot.

identifier.description: A Kraft name: lowercase ASCII letter first, then letters, digits, _ or -; at most 64 characters.

name.description: The plugin's name. The plugin.json in the source directory must declare the same name.

source.description: The plugin's directory, relative to the collection root (the repo root, or the directory added for a directory collection): ./ followed by one or more segments, with no . or .. segment, no empty segment, no trailing /, no \ or control character, and not inside .kraft/ in any letter case.
